record.field:
• Documented password policy (12-character minimum, complexity, rotation)
  • Encryption policy for data at rest and in transit
  • Tested backup and restore procedure
  • Documented incident response plan
  • Annual policy review

• Complete inventory of systems and applications
  • Map of the databases holding PI
  • List of the SaaS and cloud services in use
  • Documented data flows between systems

• Inventory of personal information by category (clients, employees, children)
  • Sensitive data identified (health, financial)
  • Register of surveillance cameras and access logs
  • Retention period set for each category

• Least privilege applied to every account
  • Periodic review of access rights
  • Separate administrator and user roles
  • Minimal collection of personal data
TLS/HTTPS, key rotation, separation of roles

• TLS 1.2+ for all communications
  • HTTPS required on every web portal
  • Valid, automatically renewed certificates
  • Periodic rotation of encryption keys
  • Separation of roles for key management
  • Encryption of sensitive emails

• Multi-factor authentication (MFA) required for administrator access
  • MFA recommended for all users
  • Centralized identity management (IAM/SSO)
  • Access revocation process when people leave

• Security patches applied within 30 days
  • EDR/antivirus on every workstation and server
  • Hardened configurations (CIS Benchmarks)
  • Centralized security event logging
  • Automatic alerts on anomalies
  • Regular review of access logs

• Firewall configured with restrictive rules
  • Network segmentation (VLAN) to isolate sensitive data
  • VPN for remote access
  • Secured Wi-Fi (WPA3 or WPA2-Enterprise)

• Physical access control to server rooms
  • Secure destruction procedure for data media
  • Physical access log
  • Protection against disasters (fire, flood)

• Regular backups (daily at minimum)
  • 3-2-1 rule (3 copies, 2 media, 1 off-site)
  • Periodic restore tests (mock-restore)
  • Documented and tested disaster recovery plan
  • Encrypted backups

• Full-disk encryption (BitLocker, FileVault)
  • Documented BYOD policy, if applicable
  • Mobile device management (MDM), if applicable
  • Automatic session lock

• Confidentiality clause in every supplier contract
  • Documented SLA with incident response times
  • Notification clause for confidentiality incidents
  • Clause for the return/destruction of data at the end of the contract
PI protection by the supplier and its subcontractors

• Written commitment from the supplier to protect PI
  • Security measures proportionate to the sensitivity of the data
  • Right to audit the supplier's practices
  • Mandatory notification of any incident involving PI
  • List of the subcontractors with access to the data
  • Same security requirements imposed on subcontractors
  • Notification of any change of subcontractor
Sovereign storage, Cloud Act, data location

• Data hosted by a sovereign provider (not subject to the Cloud Act/FISA)
  • OR on-premises hosting controlled by the organization
  • If the provider is American (Microsoft, Google, AWS): Cloud Act risk documented, PIA completed
  • No transfer outside Quebec without a privacy impact assessment
  • Preference for Quebec/Canadian providers for sensitive PI
  • Contractual guarantee of data location and control
  • Data repatriation plan, if needed
